in_sanskrit.name: अम्पिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is dear, precious and beloved

in_hindi.name: अम्पिका
in_hindi.meaning: अम्पु (ampu) - Beloved, पिका (pikā) - Beloved, Fond of
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is beloved by many and fond of

in_tamil.name: அம்பிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is deeply loved and cherished

in_telugu.name: అమ్పిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is deeply loved and cherished

in_marathi.name: Ampika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Delight, Love, Pleasing
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ampika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'ampu' meaning delight and 'pika' meaning love, pleasure or pleasing. This name is associated with the goddess Durga and represents the feminine qualities of love, compassion and delight.

This name is associated with the goddess Durga and represents the feminine qualities of love, compassion and delight.
